source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the mechanism of DNA replication (PDF 126-129).

blocks.text: Replication ka bunyadi tareeqa sab jandaron mein milta julta hai. Neeche ke qadam prokaryotes ke liye hain; eukaryotes taqreeban wahi tareeqa apnate hain.

items: Replication aik khaas silsile, replication origin site, se shuru hoti hai: prokaryotes mein aik, eukaryotes mein DNA par bohat se. Wahan initiator protein jur kar amal shuru karta hai.
Helicases ('kholne wale' enzymes) base pairs ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds torte hain; strands thore alag ho kar do Y shakal ke replication forks, mil kar replication bubble, banate hain.
Kholne se fork se aage bal (supercoils) parte hain; enzyme gyrase (topoisomerase) fork se aage jur kar unhein door karta hai.
Single-strand binding proteins akele strands ko alag rakhte aur dobara jurne nahi dete. Do forks aik doosre se door jate hain aur dono strands template bante hain.

blocks.text: Naya DNA khaali template par shuru nahi ho sakta. Enzyme primase har template par origin par 5-10 RNA nucleotides ka chhota hissa, primer, rakhta hai.

blocks.alt: Replication bubble: double helix beech se khulta hai aur dono siron par replication fork hai. Har fork par aage duplex par gyrase aur fork par helicase; peele single-strand binding proteins alag strands ko thaame rakhte hain; jamni primase har fork ke qareeb template strand par chhota primer rakhta hai.

blocks.text: DNA polymerase III, prokaryotes ke polymerases I, II aur III mein asal banane wala, azad nucleotides le kar khule template se milata hai, A ko T aur C ko G se. Khaam maal deoxyribonucleoside triphosphates (dATP, dCTP, dGTP, dTTP) hain; har aik jurte waqt do phosphate toot kar tawanai dete hain jo banane mein lagti hai.

Polymerase III sirf maujood nucleotide ke 3' sire par naya nucleotide jor sakta hai, is liye primer barhata aur 5' se 3' ki simt mein jorta rehta hai. Do template strands mukhalif simton mein chalte hain, is liye alag tareeqe se copy hote hain. Fork ki taraf chalne wale template par enzyme DNA khulne ki simt mein chalta aur leading strand musalsal banata hai. Doosre template par use fork se door chalna parta hai; DNA khulne par woh peeche naye primer par jata aur chhote Okazaki fragments banata hai, is liye yeh lagging strand ruk ruk kar banta hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat aur dilchasp baatein
blocks.text: DNA polymerase I primers badal kar polymerase III ki madad karta hai; polymerase II cell ki zindagi mein DNA ke nuqsan ki marammat karta hai. RNA primer ghalti ke imkaan wale shuru ke hisse ko aarzi nishan deta hai taa ke baad mein aasani se nikal sake. Leading strand aik primer se barh sakta hai lekin lagging strand ko har Okazaki fragment ke liye naya primer chahiye; yeh naam inhein daryaft karne wale Japani scientist ke naam par hai.

Replication aik khaas termination site par khatam hoti hai; origin aur termination site ke darmiyan ka DNA replication unit ya replicon hai. DNA polymerase I RNA primers nikal kar khaali jagahein DNA nucleotides se bharta hai, Okazaki fragments ke darmiyan bhi, aur DNA ligase lagging strand ke fragments jorta hai. Har naye DNA mein aik asal aur aik naya strand hota hai, is liye har nasl mein asal molecule ka aadha mehfooz rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Aik replication fork. Aage parental double helix par gyrase aur helicase strands kholta hai. Oopri bazu par DNA polymerase III leading strand ko fork ki taraf musalsal banata hai. Neeche lagging strand fork se door Okazaki fragments ki soorat banta hai; har tukra primase ke banaye RNA primer se shuru hota hai, DNA polymerase III use barhata, DNA ligase jorta aur single-strand binding proteins template khula rakhte hain. Teer replication ki simt dikhate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono naye strands sirf 5' se 3' ki taraf bante hain. Leading strand fork ki taraf musalsal banta hai, is liye aik primer kaafi hai. Lagging strand fork se door chhote tukron (Okazaki fragments) mein banta hai: har tukre ko naya primer chahiye, aur aakhir mein DNA ligase tukron ko jor deta hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat: biotechnology mein replication
blocks.text: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) kisi khaas DNA ki arbon copies banata hai; recombinant DNA technology mukhtalif zaraye se DNA kaat kar replication se barhati hai; genome sequencing genome ki bohat si copies bana kar us ka silsila parhti hai; aur tashkhees ke tests mareez ke DNA ke hisse copy kar ke genetic bimari batane wali mutations dhoondte hain.

Istehkaam (stability) ka matlab hai DNA durust copy hota hai: DNA polymerase III aur eukaryotic polymerases proofreading kar ke nucleotides ki tarteeb barqarar rakhte hain, jo jandar ki khasiyatein qaim aur cells ko theek chalata hai. Tabdeeli (variability) istisna hai: kabhi kabhi mustaqil tabdeeli, mutation, replication ki ghalti ya mahol ke awamil se hoti hai. Variability nayi khasiyaton ka asal zariya hai, aabadiyon ko badalte mahol mein dhalne deti aur evolution ka khaam maal hai.

blocks.prompt: Lagging strand tukron mein kyun banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Polymerase III sirf 3' sire par jorta (5' se 3' barhna). Lagging template par yeh simt fork se door hai, is liye fork khulne par enzyme ko naye primers se dobara shuru karna parta aur Okazaki fragments bante hain.

items: Helicase kholta; gyrase bal door karta; SSB proteins strands thamte; primase RNA primers rakhta.
Pol III 5' se 3' banata: leading musalsal, lagging Okazaki fragments mein.
Pol I primers badalta; ligase fragments jorta; proofreading DNA ko mustahkam rakhti.
